name: remote
title: Remote manager
summary: Urgent alerts on your phone through a Telegram bot you create yourself, decisions from the phone and a chat with the agent. Only people you pair here can use it, and only those who also set a PIN and an authenticator app here can decide and chat: approve or deny actions, answer the agent's questions, give verdicts, let held devices in, and ask the agent to look into things.
needs: An outgoing connection to api.telegram.org; nothing is opened to the internet
An authenticator app on the phone (Aegis, Google Authenticator or the like) to decide from it
A model set up in the app to chat; questions use its tokens, up to a daily allowance you set
